title: Bram and the Confession
author: Casper Eriksen
blurb: Emrys Ishikawa, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has spent seven years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
